This fixes a problem introduced by:
commit 2cde6acd49da (""netpoll: Fix __netpoll_rcu_free so that it can hold the rtnl lock"")
When using netconsole on a bond
recurse multiple times
more __netpoll_free_async's. This means there is now a race between
cleanup_work queues on multiple netpoll_info's on multiple devices and
the configuration of a new netpoll. For example if a netconsole is set
to enable 0
will likely not work.
Given the reason for __netpoll_free_async is it can be called when rtnl
is not locked
column3: we should be able to execute

column1: synchronously. It appears to be locked everywhere it's called from.
Generalize the design pattern from the teaming driver for current
callers of __netpoll_free_async.
